card.fires_on: The middle or final piece of a rare, capitalized name that is split into several parts, such as ELZONRIS, ZIRGAN, Zagros or Z-AMS-OM. The marked piece comes right after the name's first letters.

modes.description: A middle piece of a geographic or company name in general web text.
